latestVersion.changelog:
Virgin Galactic skill 1.0.0 – Commercial Space Tourism Overview

- Provides a comprehensive summary of Virgin Galactic, including company history, technology, commercial spaceflight milestones, and ticketing information.
- Details the unique air-launch system (SpaceShipTwo/WhiteKnightTwo), key flight events, and passenger experience.
- Includes competitive comparisons (Blue Origin, SpaceX) and market analysis for space tourism.
- Offers updated data on pricing, customer demographics, flight frequency, and major milestones up to 2024.
- Covers next-generation Delta-class vehicle plans, company financials, and information about Spaceport America.
